user: Small catalog merchandiser reviewing rough product listings
bottleneck: Paraphrased option descriptions hide absent cross-combinations and multiple listings in the same variant slot
AI: MiniLM independently embeds option descriptions and listing text; per-axis cosine retrieval proposes two reviewed values
deterministic: Enumerate explicitly required two-axis product, source lineage, missing/duplicate cells, observed stock sums; compare axis-only coverage

differentFrom.Catalog Concord: Matches supplier lines to canonical SKUs with unit guards; this has no canonical SKU lookup and audits cross-product gaps/collisions
differentFrom.Pairwise Foundry: Generates constrained pairwise test scenarios; this conserves existing product listings and audits a complete intended catalog grid
differentFrom.Allset Desk: Checks every supplier meets all capability requirements; this checks joint variant tuples, not a per-supplier capability set
